regime.label: Cautious, no panic
regime.summary: US stocks lower as chips sell before Nvidia's results and the Anthropic IPO. VIX about 20.5: alert, far from panic. Stoxx 600 flat near its record. Gold near a one-year low, 10-year about 5.13%. New York factory survey fell to 7.8 (about 18 expected).

brief: US stocks down about 1% as chips slide before Nvidia's results Tuesday night (TSMC -6%, Cerebras -10%). Today: sell Cerebras (stop broken), Novo lab trade moved to WAIT, and check whether the Alphabet $288 order filled.

items.text: Alphabet: place a limit BUY 1 GOOGL at $288, valid until Fri Nov 20 (cancel any $300 order)
Lab: BUY 23 NVO $42.60-42.95 if above $42, stop $41.90, sell at $45.20, hold up to 3 days
Fortinet is now WAIT: if the $125 order was placed, cancel it
SELL CBRS: the $100 stop is broken (about $97.92 at 10:25 ET). Check the live price first
NVO changed to WAIT: no buy before 21:00 Dubai, only if $42.60-42.95 after. Cancel any order now
Check whether the GOOGL $288 limit filled (traded about $286 today)
Infineon changed from mood to mixed. Order plan unchanged: still WAIT until Wed

cards.name: S&P 500 ETF (SPYM)
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $89 (Fri close $88.77). Can be placed now. Then 6 more each week while below $91.
cards.story: The 500 biggest US companies for 0.02% a year. 3.5% below its high after a -3% month.

cards.name: EVENT: Nvidia results Tue (call 02:00 Dubai Wed)
cards.trigger: HOLD. No new AI buy before the numbers. Act Wed after 19:00 Dubai using the playbook.
cards.story: Options price a move of about 9.6%. First report since the CEO resigned; the risk is the reaction, not the numbers.

cards.name: Novo Nordisk (lab swing)
cards.trigger: WAIT. No buy before the Fed speaker at 21:00 Dubai. After that, BUY only if NVO trades $42.60-42.95; skip if not by 22:00 Dubai.
cards.story: CagriSema data from early November, so the push is modest. Price sits just under the $42 floor.

cards.name: Fortinet
cards.trigger: WAIT. Do not place the $125 order (cancel it if placed). Reconsider after the Q4 report (early Feb 2027) if service growth is back above 15%.
cards.story: Not a mood drop: service revenue grew only about 13% and its guide was cut, while the firewall refresh cycle fades.

cards.name: Cisco
cards.trigger: BUY Tue Nov 17 with a limit at $96 only if CSCO closes Monday above $94. Fri close $95.64.
cards.story: Sales +24% and forecast raised, but gross margin fell to 65.6%. Part real, part mood.

cards.name: Richemont (Cartier) · Zurich
cards.trigger: BUY 2 Tue Nov 17 with a limit at CHF 170, only if CFR closes Mon above CHF 165. Now about CHF 175.
cards.story: Net profit +39%, keeps taking share. Q2 growth slowed to +13%. JPMorgan, Deutsche Bank, Bernstein back it.

cards.name: Alphabet
cards.trigger: The $288 limit may have filled today (about $286 at 10:23 ET). If not filled, it stays valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Cloud sales doubled; 28% below its high. Also benefits from the Anthropic IPO.

cards.name: TSMC
cards.trigger: Now about $373, under the $385 floor. From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 at a $395 limit only if TSM closes back above $385 first.
cards.story: October sales +59.7%. The drop is chip-sector mood, not TSMC news.

cards.name: Infineon · Xetra
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 10 with a limit at EUR 48.50 if IFX holds above EUR 46. Now about EUR 48.90.
cards.story: Guides next year +22% on data-center power chips; 45% below its high. Growth leans on one segment.

cards.name: Eaton
cards.trigger: From Wed Nov 18: BUY 1 with a limit at $335, only if ETN holds above $327. Fri close $352.97.
cards.story: Sales +28%, guidance raised a third time, yet down 17.6% in a month on data-center fears.

cards.name: Global Payments
cards.trigger: BUY 6 with a limit at $86 (pre-rumor level), valid until Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: -12% when buyout talks ended. Business unchanged, about 6.5x profit.

cards.name: Schneider Electric · Paris
cards.trigger: BUY 2 with a limit at EUR 235 (now about EUR 240).
cards.story: Organic growth +17%, guidance raised. Fell on the PTC deal, not demand.

cards.name: L3Harris
cards.trigger: WATCH. If LHX closes below $255 by Fri Nov 20 with no FAA penalty news, BUY 2 at a $255 limit.
cards.story: Blamed for the FAA ground stop, about -4%. Q3 beat and raised, record backlog.

cards.name: ServiceNow
cards.trigger: WATCH. Reconsider only if NOW closes above $105.12 and holds there through Fri Nov 20.
cards.story: Sales still +20%, but margins fell and estimates are cut. 42% below its high.

cards.name: Moderna
cards.trigger: AVOID. Do not buy the dip. Fri close $223.37 vs analyst average target $158.
cards.story: Costs stay above $4B a year, no breakeven before 2029. A drop that touches profits is not a mood drop.

agenda.event: Empire State survey 17:30; Fed's Williams 18:05; Fed Chair Warsh 21:00 Dubai
US retail sales 17:30; Home Depot, Disney; Nvidia after close (call 02:00 Wed)
Fed minutes 23:00; Target, Lowe's, TJX; Palo Alto after close
Anthropic (ANT) starts trading, range $70-78; Walmart; Intuit after close
Sandisk first day after its 8-for-1 split
Dell, HP, Analog Devices, Autodesk, Best Buy
